property_summary: For every caller who is the current owner and every proposed newOwner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) results in owner() == newOwner; the mutant that assigns owner = msg.sender instead yields owner() == msg.sender for some fuzzed newOwner (i.e., when msg.sender != newOwner) and thus violates this rule.
change_summary: Assign owner to msg.sender instead of newOwner so owner is set to caller rather than provided address.
